mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the protein threads brought the earlier cell parts together around a clear function: producing tension while the other machinery maintains and supports the cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the nuclei, ribosomes and mitochondria became somewhat repetitive, although their explanations distinguished their roles.

surprise.text: The distinction between having mitochondria and supplying their fuel clarified that assembling the machinery alone does not keep the cell working.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the named slots and compatible choices made their immediate purposes clear.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how these muscle fibers become part of a working tissue and body system. The assembly was straightforward, but that larger connection interests me.
